primary_source_receipts.locator: Secondary coverage of Vanguard How America Saves 2025 and Vanguard match-formula research
primary_source_receipts.finding: About one in six eligible workers contribute nothing; full-match capture reported as 22% for earners <=$30K and 52% for $30-60K; about 20% of $150K+ earners miss the full match. A one-third figure circulates without a verified basis.
primary_source_receipts.limitations: Vanguard report not read directly; figures from secondary coverage and vary by income.

primary_source_receipts.locator: BLS Employer Costs for Employee Compensation, December 2025 (and March/June 2025 releases)
primary_source_receipts.finding: Private industry compensation $46.15/hour worked; wages $32.36 (70.1%); benefits therefore about 29.9% of total compensation (29.7% in March 2025).
primary_source_receipts.limitations: Release not read directly; benefit share derived from the wage share; includes legally required benefits.
